initial.chief_complaint: Pain in both knees when climbing stairs, for about a year.

presenting_complaint: Pain in both knees when climbing stairs, for about a year.
history_freetext:
Gradual pain in both knees for a year, worse on the right, with climbing stairs, getting up from a chair and long walks; better with rest. Morning stiffness of about 15 minutes. Occasional creaking. No locking, no giving way, no swelling or warmth, no fever, no fall or injury.
Pain is 5 out of 10 on bad days and limits walking to about 20 minutes. Paracetamol 500 mg helps only a little. No pain at night when resting.
Hypertension controlled with ramipril; overweight (BMI 32). No heart disease, no stroke, no stomach ulcer or bleeding, no kidney disease, no asthma. No other joint disease; no psoriasis.
Ramipril 5 mg daily, paracetamol occasionally. No aspirin, no anticoagulant, no allergies to drugs.
